### Art { #p-art }

```csharp
public MenuArtMode Art { get; init; }
```

Atlas (the default) stitches every distinct variant image into one PNG, addressed by the rects the manifest records. Loose writes one PNG per variant, nested by recipe, ingredient and variant — the escape hatch for a book whose art would not fit one atlas.
